recommendations.description: Perform a claims-processing correction for inpatient AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION and Not Mapped facility claims in CA, VA, GA, OH, and PA by reconciling authorizations to paid actuals, fixing facility crosswalks, reprocessing misclassified claims, and refreshing provider and DRG views for HUNTINGTON HEALTH, Other Disorders of Nervous System with MCC, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, and Cellulitis without MCC before any denial-enforcement, site-of-care, or contract action.
evidence: CA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION contributed +$2.2M.
VA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION added +$1.0M.
VA Not Mapped claims added +$375K on 25 more admissions.
GA Not Mapped added about +$180K across UTI and Ungroupable drivers.
OH and PA Not Mapped added +$101K in high-paid cases.
Cards are flagged requires_validation_before_action and auth_or_mapping_shift.

recommendations.description: Launch a CA PPO Local acute-hospital provider action plan that audits auth-to-claim matching and denial enforcement, reviews site-of-care and preventive opportunities for UCI Medical Center and Huntington Health admission growth, and performs contract remediation plus contractual claims-processing compliance review for Hoag Hospital Newport Beach, prioritizing Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC and Other Disorders of Nervous System with MCC.
evidence: Spend is concentrated in UCI Medical Center, Huntington Health, and Hoag Hospital Newport Beach.
UCI Medical Center is volume-led with more admissions.
Huntington Health is volume-led with more admissions.
Hoag Hospital Newport Beach is mixed volume and unit cost.
Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC is a recurring driver.
Other Disorders of Nervous System with MCC is a recurring driver.
All source cards include pa_required_code Y.

recommendations.description: Implement a focused CA IP Med/Surg case-review policy at HUNTINGTON HEALTH, UCI MEDICAL CENTER, HOAG HOSPITAL NEWPORT BEACH, METHODIST HOSPITAL OF SO CA - PHYSICAL REH, and STARBURST HEALTHCARE, INC. requiring diagnosis- and DRG-specific UM review, prior-authorization verification, level-of-care review, and DRG-coding validation for SEPSIS UNSPECIFIED ORGANISM, UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED, CRITICAL ILLNESS MYOPATHY, OTHER TOXIC ENCEPHALOPATHY, ACUTE RESPIRATORY FAIL W/HYPOXIA, tracheostomy/mechanical ventilation, and Infectious and Parasitic Diseases with O.R. Procedures with MCC admissions.
evidence: CA IP Med/Surg total paid increased about $1.7M.
UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED added about $261K on 31 more admissions.
CRITICAL ILLNESS MYOPATHY added about $160K with paid per admit up.
HUNTINGTON HEALTH tracheostomy ventilation case paid about $131K.
UCI MEDICAL CENTER sepsis O.R. MCC cases added about $103K.

recommendations.description: Implement a CA PPO Local post-acute authorization and discharge-disposition policy for PA-required SNF - FREE STANDING, Physical Rehab, and NF cases that requires diagnosis-specific and service-specific level-of-care review, alternate discharge location review, and auth-to-claim reconciliation for Other Disorders of Nervous System with MCC, Cellulitis with MCC, SEPSIS UNSPECIFIED ORGANISM, OTHER TOXIC ENCEPHALOPATHY, and UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED.
evidence: CA SNF - FREE STANDING added volume across major driver cells.
CA Physical Rehab growth centered on Other Disorders of Nervous System with MCC.
CA NF added new or rare neurologic and sepsis-related stays.
CA NF intensity increased for cellulitis and OTHER TOXIC ENCEPHALOPATHY.
Key driver cells were PA-required Y.

recommendations.description: Launch a focused policy audit for LEHIGH VALLEY HOSPITAL - CEDAR CREST and LEE MEMORIAL HOSPITAL to verify prior authorization and contract-compliant payment on IP Med/Surg admissions, and apply site-of-care and discharge step-down review for Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC, NON-ST ELEVATION MYOCARDIAL INFARCT, Heart Failure and Shock with MCC, respiratory failure, and sepsis cases.
evidence: OH acute hospital added +$0.5M, led by Lehigh Valley and Lee Memorial.
PA Lehigh Valley added +$305K with paid per admit up about $6.2K.
Rare IP Med/Surg cases added +$306K, including myocardial infarct and heart failure.
Main operational drivers occur in pa_required_code = Y settings.

recommendations.description: Implement a VA PPO Local Medicare GRS policy review that establishes acute-to-SNF leakage controls from ACUTE HOSPITAL to SNF - FREE STANDING, tightens initial and concurrent review KPIs for these prior-auth services, and audits prior-auth-to-claim matching, denial enforcement, and SNF claims processing against contractual obligations.
evidence: VA ACUTE HOSPITAL PPO Local added 46 admissions with essentially flat paid per admit.
VA free-standing SNF PPO Local added 37 admissions and higher paid per admit.
Both services are prior-auth required and tagged for auth-to-claim validation.

recommendations.description: Perform case-level authorization enforcement, auth-to-claim matching, and contractual payment audit for PA-required low-volume outliers in OH/IN/ME SNF, CT acute Ungroupable, ME CRITICAL ACCESS Cellulitis without MCC, and CA/PA craniotomy stroke admissions at UCI Medical Center and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest.
evidence: OH SNF Cellulitis with MCC is PA-required and auth_dimension_present.
CT acute Ungroupable outlier is a single admission.
ME CRITICAL ACCESS Cellulitis without MCC came from two admissions.
Craniotomy stroke outliers occurred at UCI Medical Center and Lehigh Valley Hospital.
